messages:
claire: Quick flag  noticed ~52 webinar leads with no owner in HubSpot this morning. Some have conflicting owner hints in enrichment logs :thinking_face:
omar: I see mixed enrichment responses: sometimes `owner_email` is present but `owner_id` is null, other times two different owner emails returned for same lead due to duplicate cookies
lucy: that explains why the round-robin worker occasionally drops the lead: it expects a single `mkt_enriched_owner_id` and treats ambiguous results as missing -> fallback queue
ben: risky to assign when enrichment is ambiguous. Proposal: if enrichment returns multiple candidates, pick deterministic fallback (hash on email_norm) and add note "candidate owners: x,y - provisional pick" so SDRs can reconcile
raj: agree. Also we should widen the assignment grace window for webinar forms to 2m to give enrichment time, and enable 2 retries with small backoff in the enrichment lambda
claire: short-term: enable deterministic fallback + tag `pending_owner_review`, add HubSpot workflow: if owner empty after 2m assign to `sdr-inbound-provisional` and create task for SDR to verify candidates
omar: I'll roll a tiny patch: ENRICH_RETRIES=2, ENRICH_BACKOFF_MS=300, ENRICH_TTL_OVERRIDE=120 for forms matching `webinar-*`. Will canary it
lucy: also update SF sync: map `sdr-inbound-provisional` -> temporary SF queue and do NOT run territory reassignment. Opened SF ticket SF-1108
sync-bot: Salesforce sync rule updated draft saved by lucy at 1812345820
ben: metrics: add Datadog panel `webinar.enrichment.ambiguity_rate` and alert if > 5% for > 30m. Also track `webinar.assignment.provisional_count`
raj: implemented deterministic fallback snippet in rr-service and added unit test. PR GH-9009
claire: SLA to add to playbook: webinar handoff target: 90% assigned (final or provisional) < 2m, 99% < 15m. Verification: hourly check for provisional_count and ambiguity_rate; page if provisional_count > 40 for > 20m
omar: canary deployed at 1812345845; enrichment success improved and ambiguity reduced on canary instances. rolling if stable for 10m
lucy: will schedule backfill job to reconcile candidate owners for last 48h after rollout stabilizes; will append timeline notes about provisional picks
claire: thanks team. good layered approach: grace window + retry + deterministic fallback + SF mapping. will update playbook and runbook with owners and comms template
ben: i'll make the Datadog panels and alert, then post summary to #sdr-inbound when backfill runs
